shortDescription: Configures a SQL Agent job step

options.name: command
options.description: The commands to be executed by SQLServerAgent service through subsystem.

options.name: database
options.description: The name of the database in which to execute a Transact-SQL step.

options.name: job
options.description: The name of the job to which to add the step.

options.name: on_fail_action
options.description: The action to perform if the step fails.

options.name: on_fail_step_id
options.description: The ID of the step in this job to execute if the step fails and I(on_fail_action=GoToStep).

options.name: on_success_action
options.description: The action to perform if the step succeeds.

options.name: on_success_step_id
options.description: The ID of the step in this job to execute if the step succeeds and I(on_success_action=GoToStep).

options.name: output_file
options.description: The full path to the output file for the job step. This specifies where the output of the job step will be written.

options.name: retry_attempts
options.description: The number of retry attempts to use if this step fails. The default is C(0).

options.name: retry_interval
options.description: The amount of time in minutes between retry attempts.

options.name: sql_instance
options.description: The SQL Server instance to modify.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether or not the object should be C(present) or C(absent).

options.name: step_id
options.description: The sequence identification number for the job step. Step identification numbers start at C(1) and increment without gaps. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: step_name
options.description: The name of the step. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: subsystem
options.description: The subsystem used by the SQL Server Agent service to execute command.
